hospital.name: MediVista Multispecialty Hospital
hospital.description: MediVista Multispecialty Hospital is a 650-bed tertiary care facility located in the heart of Kochi, Kerala. Renowned for its patient-first philosophy, MediVista offers world-class diagnostics, surgical expertise, and digital health integration. The hospital serves over 1,200 outpatients daily and houses 18 clinical specialties under one roof.

floors.name: Ground Floor
floors.description: Primary patient-facing floor handling walk-in and emergency services.

floors.name: First Floor
floors.description: Houses specialist OPD clinics and diagnostics.

floors.name: Second Floor
floors.description: Dedicated to women's health, pediatrics, and diagnostics.

floors.name: Fourth Floor
floors.description: Critical care and intensive monitoring units.

floors.name: Sixth Floor
floors.description: Premium inpatient suites and oncology unit.

outpatient.name: Outpatient Department (OPD)
outpatient.floor: Ground Floor (General OPD) and First & Second Floors (Specialist Clinics)
outpatient.description: MediVista's OPD handles over 1,200 consultations daily across 18 specialties. Walk-in patients are registered at the Ground Floor reception. Specialist consultations are available by prior appointment on the First and Second Floors.
outpatient.how_to_reach: Enter through the main entrance on NH-66 Bypass. The OPD Registration counter is immediately to the right of the main lobby.

emergency.name: Emergency & Trauma Department
emergency.description: MediVista's 24x7 Emergency Department is equipped with 30 emergency bays, a dedicated trauma resuscitation unit, and a rapid response team. It is accessible directly from the ambulance bay on the East side of the hospital.
emergency.how_to_reach: The Emergency entrance is on the East Wing of the Ground Floor, clearly marked with red signage and accessible from the side road off NH-66 Bypass. Ambulance Bay is adjacent.

radiology.name: Radiology & Imaging Department
radiology.description: The department is equipped with a 3 Tesla MRI, 128-slice CT scanner, digital X-ray units, ultrasound machines, mammography, and a DEXA bone densitometry scanner. A radiologist is available on-site 24x7 for emergency imaging.
radiology.how_to_reach: Take the elevator or staircase to the First Floor. Follow the blue 'Radiology' signage towards the North Wing.

laboratory.name: Clinical Laboratory & Pathology
laboratory.description: MediVista's NABL-accredited laboratory processes over 2,000 samples daily covering biochemistry, haematology, microbiology, histopathology, and molecular diagnostics. Home sample collection is also available.
laboratory.how_to_reach: Proceed to the Second Floor via the central elevator. Follow yellow 'Laboratory' signage to the South Wing. Sample collection counters open from 06:30 AM.

icu.name: Intensive Care Units (ICU)
icu.description: The Fourth Floor houses all critical care units including MICU, SICU, CICU, NICU, and PICU with a combined capacity of 65 monitored beds. Each unit is staffed by dedicated intensivists, trained ICU nurses, and supported by 24x7 respiratory therapy and pharmacy services.
icu.how_to_reach: Take the elevator to the Fourth Floor. ICU visitor passes are issued at the Fourth Floor nursing station. Visiting hours: 10:00 - 12:00 and 16:00 - 18:00.

pharmacy.name: Pharmacy
pharmacy.floor: Ground Floor, Main Lobby (adjacent to OPD Registration)
pharmacy.description: MediVista's in-house pharmacy stocks over 5,000 branded and generic medications, surgical consumables, and medical equipment. A dedicated inpatient pharmacy on the Fourth Floor serves ICU and ward patients. Home delivery is available within a 15 km radius.
pharmacy.how_to_reach: Located on the Ground Floor, immediately to the left of the main OPD registration counter. Look for the green 'Pharmacy' signboard near the main lobby.

insurance.name: Insurance & TPA Helpdesk
insurance.description: MediVista is empanelled with over 40 insurance companies and all major TPAs for cashless treatment. The helpdesk assists patients with pre-authorization, claim submission, discharge summaries, and reimbursement documentation.
insurance.how_to_reach: Located at the Ground Floor Billing Section, to the right of the main pharmacy. Follow 'Insurance & Billing' signage from the main entrance.

appointments.name: Appointment Booking
appointments.description: Appointments with specialist doctors at MediVista can be booked through multiple channels: the hospital website, the MediVista mobile app, the 24x7 call centre, WhatsApp, or by visiting the OPD Registration counter in person.

channels.detail: MediVista App (Available on iOS and Android)

appointments.note: Online appointments are confirmed within 30 minutes. Walk-in consultations are accepted subject to doctor availability. Token system is used for queue management.
